text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for EmberGate (tenant: ember-001). Error: streaming_session_timeout spike + large retry bursts. Affected: EmberGate VPC App Gateway -> Redwood VPC Gateway (eu-west-1)
maya (oncall): seeing ~3000 502s on the stream path, latency jumps at 12:42 UTC. Paging oncall.
jonas (eng-runtime): logs show repeated websocket reconnects with backoff reset on client side. Server is accepting but thrashing state. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T12:42:10Z WARN conn_id=0x7f reconnect attempt=12 cause=timeout
2026-03-15T12:42:12Z ERROR tenant=ember-001 stream=ws write=broken_pipe
```
sam (eng-sre): perf dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/ember-001 shows queue depth spike and CPU hot on pool-gpu-dedicated-4. Looks like retry storm causing KV cache pressure.
luis (solutions): Ember SRE on call is @ember-sre, pinged them in the customer channel. Ember says their gateway has aggressive retries with no exponential backoff.
ember-sre (customer): confirmed. Our gateway retries immediately on 502/timeout. We can flip to exponential backoff but need coordination — naive change might expose partial results to users.
maya (oncall): action items: 1) ask Ember to disable client retries temporarily, 2) put tenant-level throttle/circuit-breaker, 3) spin up emergency dedicated pool and route Ember there, 4) limit concurrent streams per connection on our edge.
jonas (eng-runtime): I can push a tenant throttle policy now: reduce concurrency to 8 and enable soft-deny with 503 until stable. Will also enable prefix KV cache pin for ember-001 to reduce recompute.
sam (eng-sre): I'll bootstrap a new dedicated pool (ded-ember-emergency) in eu-west-1 with warm GPU instances. ETA ~11m. I'll add autoscale to +50% burst.
tess (security): any data isolation concerns with moving to a new pool? ensure KMS keys are same tenancy and audit logs preserved.
jonas (eng-runtime): no keys moved, same tenant mapping. audit logs unchanged.
ops-bot: runbook inc-streaming-throttle executed by sam at 12:45 UTC — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inc-streaming-throttle
luis (solutions): Ember, if you can cut retries for 15m while we stabilize, we can avoid customer-visible partial transcripts. Can you confirm?
ember-sre (customer): cutting retries now. switching to backoff=exp, initial=250ms -> confirmed. We'll monitor.
maya (oncall): sam, once pool up, can you kick routing for ember-001 to ded-ember-emergency and enable streaming failover to chunked-polling? We want graceful degradation not hard errors.
sam (eng-sre): routing updated (sticky session drain on old pool for 60s). failover to chunked-polling enabled for new route. 12:56 UTC status -> error rate down 70% on streams path.
jonas (eng-runtime): also set temporary retry-budgeting at the edge: allow max 2 retries client-side by injecting `Retry-After` header and `x-rw-retry-budget: 2` from proxy.
ember-sre (customer): seeing immediate improvement. Some clients still show resumed retries — we'll push a config to disable retries across the fleet.
maya (oncall): handoff: I'll stay on the thread for now, but paging schedule: @jonas you're primary for runtime mitigation, @sam for infra. If anything escalates ping PagerDuty level-2.
jonas (eng-runtime): will keep an eye. I'll also roll a tiny fix to treat multiple quick reconnects as single session to avoid KV churn. Deploying patch to canary now.
ops-bot: deployment canary started by jonas at 12:59 UTC — build r-2026.3.15-7
luis (solutions): note customer impact: Ember reports intermittent partial streaming transcripts for ~8 minutes earlier. We should open customer incident ticket and share RCA later.
maya (oncall): opened INC-2026-4587 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-4587 (embergate streaming interruptions). Adding Ember SRE contact and mitigation notes.
ember-sre (customer): thanks. we'll keep alerting if anything recurs. appreciate the rapid coordination.
sam (eng-sre): ded pool warm, traffic migrated, error rate steady ~1-2% from 70%. marking mitigation as successful for now. I'll keep metrics on 5m cadence.
jonas (eng-runtime): can we add an Eval to Redwood Optimize to detect retry storms from client patterns? Proposal: sliding-window retry rate per tenant > X triggers preemptive throttle.
tess (security): make sure those Eval logs are sanitized — no customer PII included.
maya (oncall): summary: EmberGate stream retry storm caused websocket session churn and KV cache pressure. Mitigations: customer disabled retries, tenant throttle + circuit-breaker, emergency dedicated pool + routing, enable chunked-polling fallback, small runtime patch to collapse reconnects. Impact: partial streaming transcripts for some Ember users for ~8m. Status: mitigated, monitoring. handoff to jonas/sam for post-incident RCA and runbook updates.
ops-bot: incident-bot closed PagerDuty incident at 13:12 UTC per manual resolve by maya.
